strategy.name: close_confirmed_sma_three_condition_regime
strategy.description: QQQ 初始空仓。每个交易日收盘后检查三个持仓条件：Close 高于 SMA200；SMA30、SMA200、SMA250、SMA300 每一条都连续三个交易日严格增加；SMA200 严格高于 SMA250 且 SMA250 严格高于 SMA300。只有全部条件成立才目标持有，否则目标空仓；条件状态改变后的下一交易日 Open 全仓切换。同时运行完整规则与逐一移除条件 1、2、3 的三个消融版本。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓且当日完成 Close 计算出的全部启用条件为真时产生买入信号；这是条件状态，不要求从假到真的穿越事件。完整策略启用三项条件；三个消融 case 各关闭且仅关闭一项。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓且当日完成 Close 计算出的任一启用条件为假时产生卖出信号；下一交易日 Open 全仓卖出。最后一个数据日只盯市，不虚构数据范围外成交。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日常规时段 Close 完成后。SMA 使用含当日 Close 的已完成日线；连续三个交易日增加定义为 SMA(t)>SMA(t-1)>SMA(t-2)>SMA(t-3)，四条指定 SMA 必须各自同时满足。
strategy.execution_time: 信号后的下一交易日常规时段 Open，按明确 Open 成交；不允许同日 Close 成交或 PyBroker 默认 middle price。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only，初始 100,000 美元现金；目标持有时用全部可用现金买入，目标空仓时卖出全部持仓；允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 数据起点空仓；所有 case 共享 SMA300 加三次日变化所需的完整预热，预热结束前保持现金。

parameters.analysis_start: shared first bar after SMA300 plus three completed daily increases
parameters.rising_definition: strictly positive SMA first difference on each of the last three completed trading sessions for every one of SMA30, SMA200, SMA250 and SMA300

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: At the shared post-warmup analysis start, invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ at the following trading day's Open, matching the close-signal/next-open timing convention; hold through 2026-08-04 Close without artificial final liquidation.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 unchanged: the accepted K-line controls and multi-series equity/drawdown controls cover this four-case ablation without a strategy-independent template change.

research.hypothesis: The conjunction of price, multi-horizon slope persistence, and long-SMA ordering will prioritize drawdown control; single-condition ablations reveal which gate contributes most and what return is sacrificed.
research.primary_metric: Maximum drawdown is the sole selection priority; also report total return, CAGR, Sharpe, exposure and order count for interpretability, together with same-period QQQ Buy & Hold.
research.selection_rule: No parameter selection. Compare the predeclared full rule and exactly three single-condition removals; rank drawdown only by the least negative maximum drawdown, while disclosing every return curve.
research.validation_plan: All four cases must use identical dates, capital, zero-cost next-Open execution and shared warmup; each PyBroker daily cash, shares, equity, order and closed-trade ledger must match an independent reference ledger within 1e-8 locally and 1e-6 at the formal gate.
research.promotion_criteria: None. A full-history ablation is descriptive and cannot advance directly to paper trading; any chosen rule requires later out-of-sample or walk-forward validation with costs.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject if condition 2 is not implemented as three positive differences for all four SMAs, if inequalities are not strict, if a signal uses future or incomplete data, if execution is not next Open, if case dates differ, or if either ledger comparison fails.
